summary: Implemented the rich_measure feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative DFS with explicit stack, level-based indent of 4 per level, returns Measurement(min, max)). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, Align width constraint to measured maximum (min with explicit width), and new public VerticalCenter class (render with pad=False, newline-segment padding from console.size.height, measurement delegation, repr, JupyterMixin). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options; collection still receives justify. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 Unreleased with an Added subsection (two entries) and keeps the existing entry. Tests: tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render, and measure tests; tests/test_tree.py adds import io, Measurement import, and a tree measurement test (11, 19). Existing expected strings in test_tree.py are unchanged per git diff. Tests were NOT run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. No commits made.
